conditions_of_use: 1 Release: every release names this runner commit, pins deploy/run/cps_job.py and every executed file (R10), and pins writer.admission_sha256 to research/export/ADMISSION_WRITER_V28.json (E2). The repository checkout is clean at that commit.

2 Qualification: one admission listed in the release, frozen before the first qualification prepare, pinning the runner, harness, source prep, writer admission, evaluator compare_target050.py, aggregator aggregate_qualification050.py and JOBS.json; the ledger outside every job folder (R11, R12).

3 Fresh contexts: the generator, the scope reader and the visual reviewer are each a new conversation started by the operator; the runner records the operator's attestation (reviewer kind, model, conversation ids, generation record under O40). It cannot prove freshness.
4 Rule 3: at most one technical restart per case and reader, only before the response file is written (E1); a written file goes through finish or scope-finish and is recorded as it is.
5 Visual QA: the reviewer reads every page and every tile listed in the prompt; a sheet flagged by tiles.legibility_bound_exceeded fails visual QA.
6 Delivery: only the file deliver-check prints, after it re-checks the live release and the writer admission.
7 The operator sends the run_record_sha256 printed after each command outside the VM; the record chain is unkeyed (FIXES.md section 3).
